🛠️ How do I get REAL multiplayer? / 如何開啟真正多人遊戲？

A teacher or site owner hosts the included multiplayer server just once. The easiest setup is to host the website and server together; then no separate configuration is needed. If the game is published separately on Netlify, the owner configures the connection once in server-config.js—players never see it.
Netlify alone does not run real-time multiplayer. Offline Practice is still available without a server.
老師或網站管理員只需設定一次伺服器；玩家永遠只要輸入房間號碼。

Green Valley
翠綠山谷

Walk through sunny grassy slopes, a winding river and peaceful forest trails.在陽光草坡、蜿蜒河流及寧靜森林小徑中探索。

Snowy Coast
冰雪海岸

Explore snowy shores, icy water, mountain ridges and chilly wildlife habitats.探索雪白海岸、冰冷海水、高山稜線與寒帶動物棲息地。

Desert Oasis
沙漠綠洲

Travel over soft sand dunes, visit a cool oasis and look for desert wildlife.跨過柔軟沙丘，尋找清涼綠洲與沙漠動物。

Twilight Wetlands
暮光濕地

Discover calm marshes, shallow pools, glowing plants and quiet night animals.探索寧靜濕地、淺水池、發光植物和夜行動物。

Safari Grasslands
野生草原

Run across wide flat plains and meet lions, zebras, giraffes and elephants.奔跑於廣闊平坦草原，尋找獅子、斑馬、長頸鹿和大象。

Coral Coast
珊瑚海岸

Discover sparkling ocean waves, coral reefs, dolphins and sea turtles.探索閃亮海浪、珊瑚礁、海豚與海龜的世界。

Jungle Falls
叢林瀑谷

Explore a tropical jungle with towering trees, waterfalls and riverside rescues.走進巨樹林立的熱帶雨林，在瀑布和河流旁拯救動物。

Misty Highlands
迷霧高地

Climb one giant hill, follow rocky ridges and explore mist-covered pine forests.攀上一座巨大山丘，沿岩石山脊探索薄霧籠罩的松林。

Sunset Canyon
夕照峽谷

Explore tall red cliffs, twisting sandy paths and hidden canyon passages.穿越高聳紅色峭壁、蜿蜒沙石路及峽谷暗道。

🌟 SECRET EGG LOG / 隱藏彩蛋紀錄

🥚 Legendary Secret Egg

There is only 1 secret egg in the whole game. It appears only in the rare secret map. There are no clues, no tracking instructions, and no route hints here — just luck and exploration!
遊戲入面只有 1 隻秘密彩蛋，而且只會出現在極罕見嘅隱藏地圖。呢度唔會提供任何線索、導航或提示，要靠運氣同探索。

Only the luckiest explorer can discover it!

CONTROLS / 操作說明

🌎 Explore Your World!

🖥️ Computer: WASD or arrows to move. Hold right mouse button + drag to look. Press Space to jump and E to rescue.

📱 iPad/iPhone: Drag the left joystick to walk and see the explorer take real steps. Swipe the scenery to rotate the camera. The explorer turns toward movement. Tap JUMP or RESCUE.

🐾 Approach animals, then tap Rescue to answer a wildlife question. Find treasure chests for bonus coins. Free Explore has no timer!

用左邊搖桿移動、右半邊滑動轉視角。走近動物再按「救援」回答問題，還可尋找寶箱！

🥚 Legendary Egg: One rare egg exists, hidden in a special map. No directions or clues are provided.
遊戲只有一隻傳說彩蛋，藏於神秘地圖，沒有路線提示。
